text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

translations.asad: BEHOLD, We have bestowed upon thee good in abundance:
translations.sahih: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.

translations.asad: hence, pray unto thy Sustainer [alone], and sacrifice [unto Him alone].
translations.sahih: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

translations.asad: Verily, he that hates thee has indeed been cut off [from all that is good]!
translations.sahih: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
